title: Fake-DOM piece 2: move observation-card-order / -scope / -waiting-host / -waiting-block onto loadWorld and delete observation-dom-shim.js
description:
Piece 2 of LIN-4271's approved plan. **Blocked on piece 0** (needs `document.getElementById`).

### Slice of the approved plan

| path | tests | API |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `tests/unit/observation-card-order.test.js` | 4 | `getElementById` (`observation.js:919-946`), then `remove`, `parentNode`, `appendChild`, `classList` |
| `tests/unit/observation-scope.test.js` | 8 | `getElementById` (`:444-455`). `#obs-scope [data-scope]` and `.obs-chip` already supported. **Not on the census**; it imports the shim |
| `tests/unit/observation-waiting-host.test.js` | 3 | `getElementById('obs-rulings')` (`:1981-1986`). **Not on the census**; it imports the shim |
| `tests/unit/observation-waiting-block.test.js` | 53 | `getElementById` (`:1819`, `:1838`). The rest are pure or CSS-sheet tests |

**Delete** `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js` **in this PR.** All three of its importers move here. After the PR, `grep -rl observation-dom-shim tests` finds nothing (the census entry goes too).

### Implemented (stub; design section pruned at close-out)

Implemented as the approved plan specified, PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2311](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2311>), merged as `1b83bbff`. The four suites run on `loadWorld` with names and counts unchanged (4/8/3/53, empty name diffs) and `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js` is deleted. The fake-internals replacements (waiting-block `makeSessionCard`, scope real buttons, card-order `el.dataset.session`) each went red under their mutations. The whole-`!frozen`-guard mutation survives, as the plan expected, and is filed as LIN-4290. One deviation: waiting-block's `escapeHtml` stub now also escapes quotes (page behaviour; a fixture fix). Full history is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

**Rules for every move PR (from the plan):**

* Test names and counts stay the same. Before you touch a file: `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file> | sed -E 's/ \([0-9.]+ms\)$//' > before.txt`. After: the same into `after.txt`. Paste the empty `diff before.txt after.txt` and the pass counts into the PR. The counts must equal the plan's table.
* Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js:51`) **and** add it to the consumer paragraph in the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, in the same PR (LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`).
* Delete both copies in each suite: its own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (or object-literal stubs) and its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`. Use `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js`).
* Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals. Map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards (the plan's "Fake-internals assertions" section). A replacement that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.
* Every red that a real tree raises is a finding. The PR records each one as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Fix serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, parse errors on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake.
* Never shim a missing shared-fake method in one file (no `doc.getElementById = …`). If you find a gap piece 0 missed, add it to `fake-dom.js` with its own `fake-dom.test.js` case, and say so on LIN-4271.
* LIN-4267/4268/4269 and the other pieces edit the same census list and header consumer paragraph. Before merge, update the branch against main and re-run CI on that head. `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` must be green on the merged head.
* Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (LIN-4272 files the follow-up), `select` support in the fake, and adding `style`/`getBoundingClientRect`/scroll/real event dispatch.

### Acceptance

* The four files run on the shared fake with an empty name diff and 4/8/3/53 passing.
* The fixture is deleted. Census entries for card-order, waiting-block and the fixture are removed (−3), and all four files are in the consumer paragraph.
* The mutations are recorded, including the surviving `!frozen` one.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: **LIN-4271**. Read its description's `## Implementation Plan` (the approved plan, read at `473cc865`) and its `### Plan Review Verdict` comment `db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e`, which has notes for the builder. Above that sit grandparent LIN-4255 and its course-change note `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`. **The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts.** Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4271 (and on LIN-4255 if it changes the course-change note).

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4271's approving plan-review (comment db80ceb2-14df-46c1-a163-29f74263f75e, rev 1)
* Grounding commit: `473cc865` (LinearViewer origin/main; the plan's read commit, still HEAD at breakdown on 2026-11-05, with no commits since to `tests/unit/helpers/`, the census, the fixture or the client files). Earlier beats read at `6d287518`.

comments.body:
**LIN-4281 run summary (beat 5).** PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2311, head `919671087b` (merge commit `91967108`), base `main` at `48d93c5c`. Not merged; not marked Done.

- **Moved to `loadWorld`** (names and counts unchanged): `observation-card-order` (4), `observation-scope` (8), `observation-waiting-host` (3), `observation-waiting-block` (53). Deleted `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js`; no `dom-shim` references remain.
- **Before/after:** empty diffs on all four against `aeb9d877`, after stripping the varying `ℹ duration_ms` line from both sides (the plan's `sed` leaves it in).
- **Census:** 30 entries on this head (main 33, minus the three this PR removes). Expected final is 25: five movable family suites plus `flight-companion-client`, which stops on `style` and layout reads. The 40 in the plan and the 37 I predicted earlier are both superseded.
- **Tests on the head:** targeted (`fake-dom-census`, `fake-dom`, `client-world` and the four suites) 201/201; full unit run via `scripts/run-unit-tests.mjs` 23,744/23,744, exit 0.
- **CI:** run `42065361102` on the exact head. Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and the `CI success` aggregate all SUCCESS. Mergeable and clean.
- **Main moved three times during the PR** (LIN-4269, LIN-4267, LIN-4284). Each merge's census and header conflicts were resolved to the union of both sides; the PR description records each one.

Two things recorded for the reviewer: the `!frozen` guard gap in card-order predates this PR and is described on LIN-4271 (no ticket filed); and one `task-mode-routes` failure on an earlier full run did not reproduce on any later run.

## Review — LIN-4281

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2311, head `919671087b68c1d5a955db5d0bb083c48b90e73a` (base `48d93c5c`).

CI: green on head `91967108`: run `42065361102` (Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan, `CI success` all SUCCESS). **But main has moved since:** `6dd13617` (LIN-4283, #2308) merged after this head, and `git merge-tree origin/main HEAD` **conflicts** in `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` and `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`. So CI on the merged head does not exist yet.

### Scope vs plan
The diff matches the plan's places exactly: the four suites, the fixture deletion, the census (−3: the fixture, card-order and waiting-block) and the header consumer paragraph (+4). It adds nothing to `fake-dom.js` beyond the header, so no shared-fake gap was found or shimmed. Nothing overran the plan.

### Independently re-run (my runs, not the author's numbers)
- **Before/after spec diffs.** Base worktree at `48d93c5c` vs the PR head, with the plan's `sed` plus the `duration_ms` line dropped. All four diffs are **empty**. Counts: card-order 4/4, scope 8/8, waiting-host 3/3, waiting-block 53/53. These match the plan table.
- **Shim and local fakes gone.** `grep -rl observation-dom-shim tests` is empty and the fixture file is deleted. The four suites have no `vm.`, `createContext`, `makeSandbox`, `FakeElement` or `getElementById =`.
- **Shared-fake suites.** `fake-dom-census`, `fake-dom` and `client-world` pass 133/133.
- **Assertions are preserved one for one.** I read the scope suite line by line. In waiting-host and waiting-block only the handles change (`sandbox.__nodes.get(id)` → `document.getElementById(id)`). The `{ innerHTML: '' }` head stub is now the client's own `makeSessionCard`.
- **One fixture change.** waiting-block's `escapeHtml` stub now also escapes `"` and `'`, which is the page's own behaviour. This is a fixture fix, not a loosened assertion, and it is disclosed in the PR body.

### Mutation checks (each applied to `public/observation.js`, run, then reverted; `git status` clean afterwards)
| mutation | suite | result |
|--|--|--|
| `section.hidden = total === 0` → `false` (the plan's mutation) | waiting-block | **red** 2 |
| `refreshSessionCard` no longer calls `fillSessionHead` (covers the real-card `paintedCard`) | waiting-block | **red** 2 |
| chip toggle inverted at `:453` (the plan's mutation) | scope | **red** 2 |
| scope-button toggle inverted at `:446` | scope | **red** 1 |
| `li.dataset.session` not set (covers the `dataset.session` read) | card-order | **red** 4 |
| pre-LIN-964 freeze (`expandedSessions.has(id)`) | card-order | **red** 3 |
| `nodes.length < host.limit` cap removed | waiting-host | **red** 1 |
| whole `!frozen` guard deleted | card-order | **survives**, as recorded. The ticket says record it, don't fix it here; it is recorded in the PR body and on LIN-4271 |

These agree with the PR body's own mutation table.

### Regression check
`git log` on the touched files shows LIN-964 (`adb9d5f5`, the freeze), LIN-3983 and LIN-4015, and no reverts. The LIN-964 behaviour is still pinned: the pre-fix mutation goes red.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "suite on a hand-written fake moves onto `loadWorld`". The remaining instances in `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (for example `observation-ruling-delivery` → LIN-4282, `live-console-client-facts` → LIN-4285) are other pieces of LIN-4271, each owned by its own sibling ticket. They are outside this ticket's bounded slice, so this ticket has no unhandled siblings. The surviving `!frozen` mutation is a test-strength gap that predates the PR and is explicitly out of scope here. It is recorded on LIN-4271, and filing or dropping it is LIN-4271's call.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the ticket rule "update the branch against main before merge, and `fake-dom-census` must be green on the merged head"): the head CI ran on is not mergeable cleanly. LIN-4283 (`6dd13617`) has since removed `observation-scan-due` / `lin-2933-cross-seam-witness` from the census and added them to the header paragraph. **Before the merge:** close-out merges `origin/main` into the branch and resolves both conflicts to the union. In `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js`, the list should have neither this PR's three entries nor LIN-4283's removed ones. In the `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` header, keep the LIN-4283 consumers and this PR's four `(LIN-4281)` consumers. Then run `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` locally and confirm `ci-success` is green on that new head. The distinguishing condition: the census passes, and `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` contains none of the fixture, card-order, waiting-block, scan-due or lin-2933.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The move is complete and faithful: empty name diffs, 4/8/3/53, the fixture deleted, and replacement assertions proven red under their mutations. What remains is the mechanical re-merge against main (LIN-4283) and green CI on the merged head.

## Close-out — LIN-4281

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2311, squash-merged as `1b83bbff` (`--match-head-commit 488dd5e2`). Review verdict was Approve, conditional on the re-merge against main. LIN-4281 is set to Done.

**What merged:** `observation-card-order` (4), `-scope` (8), `-waiting-host` (3) and `-waiting-block` (53) run on `loadWorld`. `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js` is deleted. The census lost 3 entries and the header consumer paragraph gained the four suites.

**Changes I made after the approval** (merge commits only; no assertion or behaviour changes):
| commit | what | review line it answers |
|--|--|--|
| `c731d6f3` | Merge main (LIN-4283, `6dd13617`). Census and `fake-dom.js` header conflicts resolved to the union. | "close-out merges `origin/main` and resolves both conflicts to the union" |
| `dca6930f` | Merge main (LIN-4282, `5f825eb6`). Same two files, same resolution. | same |
| `488dd5e2` | Merge main (LIN-4285, `8d8bd92f`). Same two files, same resolution. | same |

Main moved twice more while CI ran on each head (LIN-4282, then LIN-4285), which is why there were three merges. Every sibling piece edits the same census list and header paragraph.

**CI:** CI applies (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). Run `42071124648` on the exact merged head `488dd5e2`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and the `CI success` aggregate all SUCCESS. `origin/main` was still `8d8bd92f` and the PR `MERGEABLE` when I merged.

**Ledger**
- *Inside — the census must be green on the merged head, and `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` must contain none of the fixture, card-order, waiting-block, scan-due or lin-2933.* Done, shown by: `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` passes (43/43) on each merged head. The list has 25 entries and a grep finds none of those names. Nothing references `observation-dom-shim` under `tests/`. LIN-4282's and LIN-4285's removals are also in.
- *Outside — the surviving whole-`!frozen`-guard mutation in card-order* (a pre-existing test-strength gap; the plan says record it, not fix it). Filed as **LIN-4290**, priority Low (pre-existing, no current user-visible defect, and the narrower LIN-964 regression is pinned), labels Improvement and `kind:follow-up`, related to this ticket. No existing ticket named the same file and finding (searched). No rulings existed for this anchor.
- *Named monitor or rollback:* none was named by review, and none is needed. This is a test-only change.

**Post-deploy:** none. The change touches only `tests/` and `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`. On merged main `1b83bbff` I re-ran the four suites (4/8/3/53 pass, 0 fail) and the census (43/43), and the fixture file is gone. The post-merge `main` CI run was still queued when I last looked; it is the same tree as the green PR head plus nothing new.

**Archive and prune:** snapshot `7d3865e5` (the full pre-prune description, 5,033 chars) was verified in `/snapshots`. I pruned the "Fake-internals replacements" design section down to an implementation stub. Problem statement, acceptance, rules, scope and the `fits one session` / `plan-review due:` lines are untouched.

**Related tickets:** the parent LIN-4271 stays open because its other pieces are still open. LIN-4282 and LIN-4285 have already merged to main (`5f825eb6`, `8d8bd92f`), but they are still marked In Progress; they are not this task's to close.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4281 (stepper)

Beats (one warm implementation session, ROOT 8a064c69): 1 ground/branch/baseline · 2 migrate card-order, scope, waiting-host · 3 challenge the surviving `!frozen` mutation + migrate waiting-block · 4 delete shim, census, branch audit · 5 sync main, push, PR #2311, CI. Then fresh-eyes review (conditional Approve, comment 9453ec28) and close-out.

Evidence checked by me directly: PR #2311 MERGED as 1b83bbff; CI (Unit, E2E 1-4, Secret scan, CI success) all SUCCESS on the exact merged head 488dd5e2; LIN-4281 state Done; four suites 4/8/3/53 with empty before/after diffs; shim deleted; census 25.

Challenge raised in beat 3 (was the surviving `!frozen` mutation a loosening?) was answered with evidence: the original suite also passed under it. Filed as LIN-4290 by close-out.

Left over: post-merge CI run on main was still in progress when I looked; it covers the tree already green in PR CI. One unreproduced full-suite flake (task-mode-routes) noted in the PR.
